verdicts.reason: .flaskenv:2 sets FLASK_DEBUG=1, and requirements.txt includes python-dotenv, so Flask CLI commands load it; app/__init__.py:61 then suppresses production logging handlers, while Vagrantfile:3 assigns a reachable private-network address.

config.py:9 uses the public fallback key, while app/models.py:181-190 uses that same SECRET_KEY to sign and verify HS256 password-reset tokens. Dockerfile:1-16 and boot.sh:1-11 provide no required or generated SECRET_KEY.
Dockerfile:1-16 defines no USER after starting from python:slim, so boot.sh:4 runs migrations and boot.sh:11 executes the port-5000 Gunicorn process as the image's default root user.
